title: 6 Ready-to-Use Project Update Email Templates
summary: Send these emails to clients, coworkers, or supervisors to let them know about the status of current projects.
body_markdown:
Hello {formtext: name=name; default=there; cols=10}!


I'm emailing to provide you with an update on our current project.


By {time: MMMM Do; shift=+1W}, we will likely have accomplished our objectives.


We've accomplished the following goals:


- Site set-up
- Created landing pages


What we are currently working on in this project phase is listed below:


- SEO optimization


I wanted to get in touch with you as soon as possible to talk about the following issues:


- Publishing content


The project is on schedule, and I think we are making the required progress toward our objectives. If you have any queries, please contact me.


Best, John
